G1.criterion: B2 one-step MSE < Persistence on primary group 'robot_kinematics' (frozen_test)

G2.criterion: B2 one-step MSE < B1 (action conditioning value)

G3.criterion: B2 one-step MSE < B4 shuffled-action control

G4.criterion: horizon 5/10 rollouts finite and skill > 0 vs Persistence

gates.note: Gates use mean improvements on frozen_test; paired bootstrap CIs are reported separately as statistical support, not as a substituted claim.

scientific_caveats: Pusher-v1 has 0/30000 fingertip-object contacts; no pushing claim.
ood_test differs only by reset seed; NOT a verified OOD split.
frozen_test was never used for training, early stopping or alpha selection.
